Not a search budget: a publishability limit. GitHub refuses a file over 100 MiB, so the bulk export is sharded under 90 MiB and the builder RAISES on any oversize artifact rather than shipping one. The list of offenders is named in the failure.
Caps the uncovered-ingredient list at 250 per food record. The builder sets `truncated` and writes "(capped at 250)" into the record's own note, so a capped list is never presented as a complete one.
Linked from the nav of every page and from the masthead of index.html.
#resultline carries role=status aria-live=polite and states both counts.

Measured on the entry page: 2,084 KB uncompressed over 5 requests on a local server, of which data/web/catalog.json is 1,989 KB. GitHub Pages serves it gzipped, where the same load is about 360 KB. The budget is set against the uncompressed figure because that is what a local Gate 4 probe measures; patterns.html and methods.html read data/web/summary.json instead and load 182 KB and 206 KB.
